serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Normal+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: What? You still don’t remember? There’s something seriously wrong with your mind.
You: What is that supposed to mean?!
Mrs. Fisher: Whatever, just try casting your rod again, let’s see if you got any better. 
You: Sure.
#mrsfisher.Face.Normal
You: What?! I can’t believe it! It went so far!
Mrs. Fisher: It seems like it worked this time around.
You: I have no idea what changed, but thanks a lot! I’m so happy I don’t need to smoke that joint ever again.
#mrsfisher.Eyes.AngryClosed+mrsfisher.Mouth.Grin
Mrs. Fisher: Yeah, about that. 
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Normal+mrsfisher.Mouth.Grin
Mrs. Fisher: Since you still can’t remember a thing, there’s still some kind of blockage. You will have to continue.
You: Are you serious…
Mrs. Fisher: If you are so against it, you can stop. All I’m saying is that you can still improve by doing it.
You: Sure…
You: I’m tired now. And sweaty. I will come back later…
